zh.title: 湾区房源搜索方法
zh.seo_title: 湾区房源搜索方法｜陈靖
zh.description: 怎样在湾区高效找房？本文讲如何设定必须项、用地图和提醒搜索、看房时记录什么，以及带看前的买方协议、Open House 注意事项和网站估值、学校标注的常见误区，帮助你缩小范围。
zh.lead: 搜房的目的是缩小范围。先定标准，再用同一张表比较每一套房。

en.title: How to Search for a Bay Area Home
en.seo_title: How to Search for a Bay Area Home | Jing Chen
en.description: Set must-haves, search by map, record what matters at showings, and avoid traps with listing school names, portal estimates and open houses.
en.lead: Searching is about narrowing. Set your criteria first, then compare every home on the same sheet.
